purpose: Coordinate multiple AI agents working on the ESP32 Virtual Control Lab without relying on conversation memory.

status_vocabulary.ready: Agent or role can start when assigned.
status_vocabulary.active: Agent is currently working on the named scope.
status_vocabulary.needs_owner: Agent needs user input before meaningful progress can continue.
status_vocabulary.blocked: Agent is blocked by missing evidence, missing hardware, failing dependency, or unresolved decision.
status_vocabulary.review: Agent output needs verification before status can advance.
status_vocabulary.done: Agent completed the listed work and left evidence.

coordination_rules: Every agent must read AGENTS.md, docs/AI_CONTINUITY_SYSTEM.md, docs/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md, docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/PROMPT_TEST_LIBRARY.md, data/progress-baseline.json, and this file before changing project state.
Every agent must claim one narrow scope before editing.
No agent may bypass the central control loop or move decision authority away from the ESP32.
No agent may mark roadmap tasks, branches, or gates complete without evidence.
When an agent changes durable status, it must update docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, data/progress-baseline.json, and this coordination file.
When public reporting changes, mirror docs and data into web-build/docs and web-build/data, deploy web-build, and push to GitHub.
If two agents touch the same file or blueprint branch, the later agent must review the earlier agent's work before editing.
